name: NYC Domestic Violence Hotline
region_note: IF PEOPLE ARE AT RISK TOO
notes: (800) 621-4673 - nyc.gov/content/endgbv/pages/hotlines - abuse of a person alongside a pet, safety planning, leaving safely. Also reachable as 800-621-HOPE. 24/7, confidential, multilingual. Takes anonymous calls.
section: Report animal abuse — IF PEOPLE ARE AT RISK TOO

change_log.note: Tried on 2026-11-04: nyc.gov answers "Access Denied" to automated browsers. Nothing changed; a person needs to open it in a normal browser and record what they see.

A reviewer read its own site on 2026-11-04 and Claude read it the same day. The city's page gives 1-800-621-HOPE (4673), the number listed. (212) 639-9675 on the same page is the number for 311 from outside the city.
